name: @poot/shard-engine
description: CloudMine Shard Engine - C++23 with WASM via Emscripten

scripts.build: if command -v em++ >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmake -B build -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=./emscripten-toolchain.cmake && cmake --build build; else echo 'WARNING: Emscripten (em++) not found. Skipping WASM build for shard-engine. Building native library instead...'; npm run build:native; fi
